nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Forehead Pimple Patches

avis.titre: Love the pimple patch, not this
avis.texte: Difficult to get the product off of the protective film. Edges of the patch don't stick to skin but peel up.Didn't remove that much. Had better resulting putting the pimple patches all over.
I couldn't find these in store so I bought them online and they are greatt! They work for me when I breakout (which is like 24/7).

avis.titre: Love the patches - the strip is just as good
avis.texte: I use the patches all the time and love them. Just got the forehead strips and its veryyyy light weight, and as clear as the "Invisible" Patches in case you really needed to wear it during the day lol.

I was given a free sample to try of this product. The review is honest and my own. I let both of my daughters who have acne try this product over a week. Overall, they both saw improvement in the acne on their forehead. They were easy to use and apply. Overall they enjoyed their results and would buy other products from the same brand.

Mighty Patch Forehead patch is thinner then original and I can't feel it on my forehead.There are no ingredients in Mighty Patch Forehead patch , just the hydrocolloid. The patch naturally extracts pimples without hurting your skin, thereby allowing your skin's natural healing to take over.I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. I've used the original pimple patches and those work great. I was excited about this because product because it covers a good amount of my forehead. I wore it to bed and the patch didn't shift. It was effective in flattening my raised pimples overnight.

The Hero Mighty Patch Forehead is a hydrocolloid patch designed specifically for breakouts on the forehead. This patch is super easy to use and is clear so it's barely noticeable. The patch itself is thin and flexible and it sticks really well. The one thing that I really like about it is that it's not uncomfortable to wear. I place it on and leave it for 6-8 hours or until it turns white. It does a really great job at removing all the gunk and impurities. I definitely recommend giving this product a try if you struggle with unwanted breakouts in this area. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. #ad #freesample

I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. I experience acne across my forehead and found these patches to be great at calming down the inflammation. Highly recommend!! #freesample

I received the mighty patch forehead for free for my honest review. My opinion is my own. I did not know what to expect but this patch worked.. And it is so easy to use and felt light on my forehead. I hardly noticed it. I slept with it on overnight and when I removed it my forehead was clear - felt really clean, not sticky, soft and impurity free. I would recommend this patch

I received this product as a sample for my honest opinion and I honestly thought how much could this one big patch do and the answer is A LOT. It covered my entire forehead and cleared up the area great while not drying it out or causing other issues. The patch stayed on for the recommended time which is a long time but it didn't shift while I was sleeping. I would recommend this product to anyone who has acne issues.

I've used the mighty patches from Hero before, and really like them. I applied it before I slept and removed it the next morning. I guess I didn't have a lot of gunk on my forehead, because the patch didn't have any whiteish spots on it. Instead, I found mostly peach fuzz and maybe some sebum plugs adhered to the patch. Removing the forehead patch was a bit of a struggle compared to the mighty patches (likely due to the larger surface area), and it left my forehead a little wrinkled and lightly tacky to the touch. After splashing my face with water as I normally do in the morning, this went away. I would use the product again because it did pick up some things. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

I received these Mighty Patch Forehead Patches and allowed my teenage daughter with acne to try them. She found them to be very helpful. She picks a lot, so it's good that these help to break that habit. The patch absorbs weepiness and allows the skin to heal overnight. She felt they made a difference. If she would like to purchase them again, we will. "I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own." #ad

My forehead acne was diminished using the patch but it's not wide enough for the big forehead girlies. It missed several bumps. Also, I wouldn't use this is you don't shave your forehead like me...it says don't use on hair but jeez I didn't think it meant the microscopic hair!

I love Mighty Patch products, so it's been fun using this new forehead patch. It fits perfectly on my face and covers a nice large area so I can address multiple breakouts at once. It is super gentle on my skin and comes off nicely. I did not see a reduction of blackheads on the first use, but my forehead looks clear on the second use. It did not do much for a whitehead that I have, but maybe it will go away on the third try. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

Because the patch is so large I was able to cut it in half and get twice the use! Even though it's for your "forehead" you can literally use it anywhere on your face. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.
I love the new forehead patches. They work great to reduce oils in my skin and you can really tell and feel a difference! I'd definitely recommend these patches to anyone!

avis.titre: Hero Mighty Patch Forehead Patch: A Teenager's Acne Game-Cha
avis.texte: The Hero Mighty Patch Forehead Patch is nothing short of a miracle for acne-prone teenagers. I recently used it on my teenager, who often struggles with acne on their forehead. After applying the patch overnight, the results were astonishing. By morning, the acne had significantly reduced in size and redness, and some pimples had completely vanished. The patch adheres well and is practically invisible, making it easy for my teenager to wear it throughout the night without discomfort. Not only does it effectively treat existing acne, but it also helps prevent further inflammation and breakouts, thanks to its innovative hydrocolloid technology. Overall, the Hero Mighty Patch Forehead Patch is a game-changer for those battling forehead acne. It delivers quick and noticeable results, making it a reliable and convenient solution for teenagers and anyone seeking a hassle-free way to combat acne.

These forehead patches are amazing! I have very dry skin, so I was a bit worried about using this because some products similar to this literally rip a layer of skin off my face when removing it. But, I'm so glad I gave this a chance because it really works! I put it on before bed and slept with it on for about 7ish hours and had no issues with removing it in the morning. It cleaned out all the gunk and made my skin feel and look brand new. It's difficult to have a one size fits all product since not all foreheads are the same but even though there were a few creases, it was still secure and very effective. I will definitely be repurchasing and adding this to my routine! I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

Works great and stays on well. Works the best when you have zits that are ready to be popped (whiteheads), doesn't work for underground ones at all. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

This pimple patch designed to fit your forehead by Hero is brilliant! I really appreciate the size of the patch and how effective it is at removing the gunk from my pores and leaving my skin less shiny. It comes in a 5 count box and is easy to apply and remove. I highly recommend this if you have trouble with acne on your forehead. I received this product free for my honest review. All opinion are of my own.

I have been using the forehead patch for a couple of days and it does such and amazing job! I've used it on my active pimples and it sucks all the gunk right out and immediately reduces the inflammation, redness and overall appearance of them. I really liked how this pimple patch did what it was supposed and did not dry out my skin at all. Would definitely recommend for those who struggle with active breakouts on the forehead.

I have been dealing with acne on my forehead and typically do not have acne there. I think I narrowed it down to hair care, but in the meantime these forehead patches were a lifesaver! Rather than having to go all over with small patches, I could just lap one of these on overnight and be good to go.

I've been dealing with acne on my forehead recently so these came at the perfect time. I did receive these in exchange for a review and I am so thankful as they came in so handy. I did my regular routine and then before bed I slapped one of these big patches on and it worked perfectly!

So I have been having acne problems on my t zones. And this Mighty Patch Forehead Patch definitely lives up to its expectations. Putting it on before bed, and waking up to reveal the result makes it even better! Thank you HERO!!

I recieved the Hero Mighty Patch Forehead patch for free in return for my honest review. I have to admit I was skeptical, and I received the product and the very next day I woke up with a pimple! So I got to try the mighty patch for the first time. By the end of the day the pimple was nearly gone! I couldn't believe it, I was a skeptic but now I definitely will be purchasing this again and again. Highly recommend! #ad #freesample #honestreview

I received this free to try out, but my opinions here are 100% my own. I love that the patch covers the area where i'm prone to getting a bunch of little bumps at. I'm also super oily in this "T-zone" but the patch did not dry out my skin OR make it feel more oily. It seemed to pull out a lot of gunk as well as making my skin softer after use. It's definitely one of the better patches I've tried. and it doesn't leave behind any sticky residue !!

I love the acne patches by Hero so I figured the forehead patch would also be high quality. I loved that the patch was able to be used overnight but still peeled off relatively pain free, not like those patches that seem to rip a layer of skin off. It seemed to clear the junk out of pores while I slept. The patch stayed put, which is why I love the Hero brand patches because they seem to stay put way better than other brands. It worked well and prevents forehead acne. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

Heros Mighty Forehead patches are genius! When you have more than one stubborn pimple on your Forehead instead of using like 5 individual patches.. you use one big one! I had the pleasure of receiving a free sample and when I tell you this product is life changing I'm not exaggerating! It's easy to use, it's convenient and gets all the gunk out in one shot, in one patch. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. I would definitely purchase with my own money!

If you've ever felt that you basically need a Mighty Patch to cover your entire face, then this is for you, because it is HUGE. It's by far the largest patch I have ever used, but despite the size, it is very easy to wear because it is thin and discreet. Slap one of these on before you go to bed, and it visibly shrinks things down to a much flatter and more tolerable state. If you wear makeup like I do, then your blemish will be a lot easier to conceal on the following morning, and if you use them 2 days in a row, your blemish will be practically healed. FYI--If it's too big, you can also cut it in half easily with scissors. I wish these had existed in my teens. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own. #ad
I can't believe how fast this made my forehead blackheads clear up! Not only that, I noticed my skin looking smoother & better than ever!
This is by far the best product to clear up my forehead that I have ever tried. I will definitely be recommending this to my friends.
Nothing has given me better results than this product. I have repurchased time and time again and recommend to everyone I know.
I just wish it was a little bigger so that it reached my temples
This Product is a must have! I can't believe how well this worked!! I will Definitely be needing this for now on!!
